$comment: Machines that can run the joed.dev stack. Each is a Linux environment with Docker (native, WSL2 or a Mac VM) on the Tailscale network, reached as `user@tailscale` over Tailscale SSH (or `user@address`, e.g. a LAN IP, while a host isn't on the tailnet). `skip`: compose projects this host must not run (hardware it doesn't have: Bluetooth, PulseAudio, the LAN DNS IP). `skipRepos`: repos whose deploy jobs stay on the other host when this one is promoted (they drive that hardware). `publicChecks`: URLs that must return 200 after a promote. `gateHost`: an app behind the joed.dev sign-in that every host serves; promote checks it redirects to the sign-in. Which host is ACTIVE isn't stored here: it's whichever runs the cloudflared container (see ci/scripts/host/status.mjs). Add a host with the `hosts` skill or docs/hosts.md.

watchdog.$comment: ci/scripts/host/watchdog.sh, on every host: a standby takes over when these sites get Cloudflare's no-tunnel errors and the active host is gone; alerts go to alertTo through site-mail.

hosts.name: glados
hosts.notes: 2014 MacBook Pro, 4 threads, 7 GiB, Wi-Fi. Owns the Bluetooth speaker (LEXON MINO) and the LAN DNS (coredns on 10.0.0.172).
